thread:
maria: Heads up — noticed ~150 invoices from last night's NetSuite sync missing coupon line items (total discount lost ~$4.6k) :warning:

tom: that's bad. any pattern? are they all the same coupon?

maria: mostly 'Q1-LAUNCH' coupon, and only for invoices created between 00:40-01:15 UTC. Others have discounts fine.

anish: did webhook retries flood and create duplicate invoice drafts? @billing-bot any DLQ alerts?

billing-bot: [automated] webhook-retries: invoice.finalized events 00:38-01:18 => 213 attempts, 12 DLQ'd. see /alerts/webhook-retries/1964

maria: here's a sample payload we received (sanitized):
```json
{"id":"inv_01Fxxx","customer":"cus_123","coupon_applied":true,"coupon_id":"cpn_q1","lines":[{"amount":1000}],"total":900}
```
But NetSuite record shows lines without coupon line (net_amount = 1000, expected 900).

tom: could be ordering: we apply coupon when invoice.finalized fires, but if invoice.posted arrives first and our processor marks invoice as posted in NetSuite, we skip updating lines on later events. Are we using event dedupe or idempotency keys?

anish: current webhook worker dedupes on event_id only. If events reorder, we process 'invoice.posted' then 'invoice.finalized' later — finalization handler is a no-op if external record already exists.

sophie: are these refunds happening or customer-facing issues? finance needs an estimate of exposed customers.

maria: about 72 customers affected, small dollar each. I ran a quick query: SELECT invoice_id FROM ns_invoices WHERE coupon_missing=true AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-04-10T00:35Z' AND '2026-04-10T01:20Z'

tom: fix: change finalization handler to be idempotent and re-check coupon fields against source-of-truth. Also add dedupe on invoice_id + coupon_id, not just event_id. We should also make 'invoice.posted' handler tolerant and merge later incoming fields.

anish: agree. quick patch: if external invoice exists, update lines instead of skipping. I'll open PR.

maria: also need a backfill to patch NetSuite for affected invoices. sample command I ran to preview:
```bash
python scripts/backfill_ns_coupons.py --since 2026-04-10T00:30Z --until 2026-04-10T01:30Z --dry-run
```
Preview shows 72 updates.

sophie: finance approves backfill + production run tonight after 22:00 PST. Make sure idempotent and log per-customer diff. Also notify CS for any billing emails. :white_check_mark:

anish: will implement handler patch now. tagging @tom for review. PR ID: 4521

tom: reviewing. after merged we'll run backfill in staging, then run prod backfill with runbook.

maria: I'll draft runbook steps and message to #support with list of affected customers. We should also add metric to Redwood Console: 'coupons_applied_rate' by time windows.

billing-bot: [automated] deploy-bot: PR 4521 passed CI, queued for deploy.

anish: merging now. ETA 30m for canary.

sophie: thanks team. please include retrospective note in postmortems channel after fix. :thumbsup:
